findings.motion: H.4000 (FY2026 budget), adoption of amendment #409 'An Act relative to identification to vote' (House Roll Call No. 36 of the 2025 journal list entry dated 04/29/2025 8:33 PM, failed 25-131)
findings.note: The roll call lists her as voting N. The amendment, filed by Rep. Lombardo, would replace the polling-place check of voter names with a requirement to show valid identification. Text at https://malegislature.gov/Bills/GetAmendmentContent/194/H4000/409/House/Content. Roll-call number in the journal PDF is No. 42.

findings.motion: H.5500 (FY2027 budget), adoption of amendment #1587 'An Act relative to identification to vote' (House Roll Call No. 174, failed 27-131)
findings.note: The roll call lists her as voting N. The amendment, filed by Rep. Lombardo, would require a valid State or Federal photo identification before a voter receives a ballot and lists acceptable photo IDs. Text at https://malegislature.gov/Bills/GetAmendmentContent/194/H5500/1587/House/Content.
